subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` final recovery ship as this PR's default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` option, or should maintainers prefer the open default-recovery successor?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same P1 silent message-loss class, but they encode different operator action, upgrade, and privacy/product contracts that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prefer Default Recovery
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 the canonical fix if maintainers want existing affected users protected without a new config knob.

options.title: Land Opt-In Recovery
options.body: Continue with this PR if maintainers explicitly want recovery behind a new `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config surface.

options.title: Keep Warning-Only Contract
options.body: Close both recovery implementations if maintainers decide warning-only `message_tool_only` behavior is the permanent privacy contract.

recommendation.title: Prefer Default Recovery
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 the canonical fix if maintainers want existing affected users protected without a new config knob.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated adjacent auto-reply/config work, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the product-contract choice.
